summary: Admitted goal 3: make the external research capability product canon from the September 2026 campaign evidence. Scope is one owner document, one contracts pair, consumer references and this ledger. Continuation 5 had not reported; its results are recorded as open questions rather than canon placeholders.

Compiled Plans/External_Research.md with ERS-001 to ERS-014 and registered it exactly as the previous owner document was registered: appended to sharding_config sources, a dated Change Summary bullet with a ContractRef, a named Plan map section, and a root shard-index row. Shards and the plan index regenerated in the same commit (bad2b3dc94).

Compiled the contracts pair with six closed record shapes, 12 positive and 30 negative fixtures, registered in the closed CONTRACT_PAIRS manifest of scripts/pm-new-contracts-verify.py with the authored cardinality raised from 30 to 31, and registered as ATS-054. validate-new-contracts passed with 0 findings (a160213d21).
Compiled ACD-467, PLS-023 and SSYS-037 as consumer references that point at this owner rather than restating its contracts (dffb268174).

Recorded four open questions: continuation 5's review-configuration result, continuation 5's per-stage latency against the 75-minute target, the governance coverage reseal for the two owner docs outside Spec_Lock and plan_graph coverage, and the consumer reference that belongs in the owners a concurrent branch holds.
Published the compact result bundle under reports/external-research-canon-20260917/ and stopped the branch for independent review. Nothing here is landed on main.

Repaired this compile against the deterministic compile witness (scripts/pm-ledger-compile-witness.py, landed at 4f5eda0d18) and two blind form-driven reviews of the draft. Two defect classes were repaired and no schema or fixture semantics changed. First, sixteen preserved_exact_tokens entries across nine units named strings the unit's own text did not contain. Twelve are promises the unit does make in other words, and the unit's prose now uses the registered words: ERS-002 names the reconcile and compare stage identifiers the schema's stage enum uses, ERS-004 carries the atom's ordinary-words class name unsupported or already-covered beside the unsupported_or_covered enum, ERS-007 says accepted for planning and unapproved optional capability, ERS-008 says native records, ERS-009 names the bound_by field its terminal record reports the binding limit in, ERS-013 says same family, ERS-014 says protocol fingerprint, runtime identity and output manifest, which until now appeared only in the document's overview list outside the unit, and PLS-023 names the standing repair authorization inside the unit as the addendum above it already did. The other four were dropped rather than restored: ERS-005 registered Approve, Deny, Deny with changes and Ask a question, which DL-036 and ACD-467 own and state and which ERS-005's own negative constraint forbids it to restate, so its registry now declares what this unit itself states. That entry is the one the landed review created when it removed the enumerated response fields from ERS-005 and left their tokens registered. Second, four exact atom tokens appeared in owner prose but in no owner registry: ATS-054 gains CONTRACT_PAIRS and 30 negative fixtures, ACD-467 gains text labels, and PLS-023 gains ledger question record. All three witnesses now pass on this ledger.

Dispositioned the eighty-two findings four blind form-driven reviewers raised on this compile, two on the draft the landed review saw and two on the draft after its fixes. Each claim was checked against the text, the shipped schema and the cited sources rather than against the reviewer's own quoted evidence. The confirmed prose repairs applied here are: ERS-013 said three obligations hold and states four; ERS-009 and the Settings consumer reference said the per-job limits are what ends most jobs, while the run they cite ended 33 of 80 jobs on a per-job limit, finished 47 and ended none on the cost cap; ERS-010's premise that review models differ in depth rather than in kind contradicted ERS-011's own measurement that at the margin they differ in kind, and is now qualified to agree with it; ATS-054 and the assistant-chat-design consumer reference narrowed the decision-card negative constraint from colored border bars to colored status bars, while the schema field is colored_border_bars; and ATS-054 dropped the atom's constraint that nothing in the contracts verifier changes beyond registering this pair. Two reviewer findings were checked and rejected because repairing them would have made canon less accurate: validate-new-contracts is both separately invocable and a named subcheck, so both ATS-054 statements are true; and the published-tariff and zero-floor rule in ERS-008 is grounded in a source the unit cites, so removing it would orphan the schema's tariff_floor valuation basis and its negative fixture. Four confirmed findings need an owner decision or a schema change and are recorded as open questions q-005 through q-008 rather than repaired. The remaining findings, their dispositions and the reasons are in reports/compile-repair-20260917/.
